LanguageData.GR_TokraCipherStudy_CommandDescription: Assign a colonist to carry the recovered Tok'ra cipher module to a research bench and examine its protected memory lattice. Three careful analysis sessions are required.
LanguageData.GR_TokraCipherStudy_TargetingLabel: Choose a colonist to analyze the cipher module
LanguageData.GR_TokraCipherStudy_NotRecoveredModule: This is not the cipher module recovered during first contact.
LanguageData.GR_TokraCipherStudy_HomeMapRequired: Bring the recovered module to a player colony before analyzing it.
LanguageData.GR_TokraCipherStudy_InvalidModule: The selected device is no longer the recovered Tok'ra cipher module.
LanguageData.GR_TokraCipherStudy_CopyInspect: This device does not carry the identity of the cipher module recovered during first contact.
LanguageData.GR_TokraCipherStudy_BringHomeInspect: Recovered Tok'ra cipher module. Bring it to a player colony for analysis.
LanguageData.GR_TokraCipherStudy_ReadyInspect: Recovered Tok'ra cipher module: ready for analysis at a research bench.
LanguageData.GR_TokraCipherStudy_CompletedInspect: Cipher-module analysis complete. Tok'ra secure communications research is unlocked once its normal prerequisites are met.
LanguageData.GR_TokraCipherStudy_ProgressText: {0} has isolated another stable layer of the Tok'ra memory lattice. The module remains intact, but further careful study is required before its recognition protocols can be reproduced.
LanguageData.GR_TokraCipherStudy_CompletedText: {0} has completed the direct analysis of the recovered cipher module. The final pass dismantled the sealed device, but its decoded recognition lattice now provides everything needed for {1}.
LanguageData.GR_TokraCipherStudy_ReplacementText: A concealed Tok'ra courier has left a replacement cipher module inside the colony perimeter. The contact offers no explanation, but the device carries the same recognition lattice as the one lost before analysis could be completed.
LanguageData.GR_TokraCipherStudy_DebugDestroyed: The tracked Tok'ra cipher module was destroyed.
LanguageData.GR_TokraCipherStudy_DebugReplacementDue: The replacement cipher module is now due.
LanguageData.GR_TokraCipherStudy_DebugUnavailable: The Tok'ra cipher-module study action is unavailable in the current state.
